method: Reviewed the complete lesson against OWASP GenAI LLM01:2025, Anthropic Messages tool-call and stop-reason documentation, and DeepSeek Anthropic compatibility docs. Ran a local FakeClient harness against the exact Python fence, validated tool-call envelopes before any fake sink, and asserted incomplete stop states and empty end_turn behavior. No provider request or external network call.
limitations: Historical 0/7 model observations lack raw provider responses and a reproducible denominator; no historical model experiment was rerun.
The FakeClient only validates local control flow and fake sinks; no production authorization, approval, side effects, or endpoint behavior was tested.
Compatibility of provider stop_reason values and schemas must be verified for each target model and endpoint.
